verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents its own client-library SDK (Python, C++). Through it, programs can command robots via topics, services and actions (goals, feedback, cancel). Its SROS2/DDS-Security layer provides participant authentication, encryption and per-enclave policies that can be mapped to processes, users or devices, which serve as scoped credentials. However, nothing in the evidence addresses AI agents specifically. Driving a real robot end-to-end is shown only through generic primitives and a simulation tutorial. Missing for 10: any AI-agent-oriented integration or guidance, documented end-to-end control of real hardware by an autonomous agent, independent hands-on corroboration of scoped-credential agent control.
